name: steamtags
title: steamtags
blurb: pick any Steam game and see its community tag cloud, sized by vote count — then rate for yourself how well each tag actually fits, 1 to 10. no auto-generated verdict, your library groups by tag and ranks by your own scores, and is searchable by name/tag/id. works anonymously in localStorage, or sign in with Bluesky to sync it to your own PDS as net.bisks.steamtags.rating. also does Steam OpenID login to verify who you really are (ratings made while connected get a checkmark), and links out to SteamDB for each game. @7778777.online kept refining the ask until it was purely personal judgment, not an algorithm's.
